pluginMetaData.name: Message Flow
pluginMetaData.author: Synthesis Health, Keith Smith
pluginMetaData.description: Visualizes how channels route to one another: Channel Writer destinations, router.routeMessage()/routeMessageByChannelId() script calls, and every destination that leaves the engine. Adds a Message Flow nav tab, a "View in Message Flow" channel action, and a Message Flow tab in the channel editor, plus a per-message trace showing one message's actual runtime lineage. Requires the Web Support plugin, which hosts the web administrator this UI runs inside.
